summary: GnuCOBOL 3.1.2 build of the returned tree on the panel's own inputs: '10004821X;PAY;1.00;cash' against the sample readings prints 'LINE   1 REJECTED BAD ACCOUNT' (COUNT IN = 9, characters examined), and ADJ -1.20 / ADJ -1.50 / REF -1.20 / FEE -1.20 / PAY -1.20 all print 'WHOLE     -2' (FUNCTION INTEGER = floor); the returned reference output is byte-identical on both pairs. The graded corpus already decides the same rules: expected postings_rounding_modes.stmt lines 55 and 66 ('ADJ -12.35 WHOLE -13', 'ADJ -0.50 WHOLE -1') and generated_01.stmt line 112 ('LINE  11 REJECTED BAD ACCOUNT' for account field 123456789) were produced by the verifier's own COBOL build and the reference passed them on the platform (oracle 54/54).
